article.en: As we had had a long walk through one of the markets of old Delhi, we stopped at a square to have a rest.
article.zh: 我们在旧德里的一个市场里走了很长一段路后，在一个广场上停下来休息。

article.en: After a time, we noticed a snake charmer with two large baskets at the other side of the square.
article.zh: 过了一会儿，我们注意到广场的另一边有一个带着两个大筐的耍蛇人。

article.en: We went to have a look at him.
As soon as he saw us, he picked up a long pipe which was covered with coins.
article.zh: 他一看到我们，就拿起一支长长的笛子，笛子上镶着硬币。

article.en: When he began to play a tune, we had our first glimpse of the snake.
article.zh: 当他开始吹奏一支曲子时，我们第一次看见了那条蛇。

article.en: It rose out of the basket and began to follow the movements of the pipe.
article.zh: 蛇从筐里探出身来，随着笛子的摆动而扭动起来。

article.en: The snake charmer suddenly began to play jazz and modern pop songs.
article.zh: 耍蛇人突然改吹爵士乐和现代流行乐曲。

article.en: The snake, however, continued to 'dance' slowly.
article.zh: 然而那蛇却继续缓慢地“跳舞”。

article.en: It obviously could not tell the difference between Indian music and jazz!
article.zh: 显然，它分辨不出印度音乐和爵士乐的区别！
